doc.title: Stanley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

title: Tape change and the Grammy for Ellington liner notes
summary: Rowe pauses to flip the cassette; Dance mentions sharing the first liner-notes Grammy with Leonard Feather.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: We’re just about — we’ll wrap up here. I’m going to let Tim flip our cassette so that we don’t lose anything. I see you also have won a couple of awards — A Grammy note for Duke Ellington.
Yes that was the first Grammy for liner notes. I shared that with Leonard Feather. Yeah, he wrote half of it, I wrote the other.
